snippet.title: Basketball Career Simulator: Bball Destiny Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the basketball career simulator free: https://bballdestiny.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer
Bball Destiny: start at 16, make every call and chase the Hall of Fame. In the browser, on iPhone and on Android.

Declare for the draft, or wait one more year? Every season, the calls are yours: college or Europe, sign now or bet on yourself. Every call moves your ratings. Win gold for your country, come back from a torn knee, win the title and see your number go up in the rafters. Every career ends on a card.

Over 50,000 careers played. About 1 in 100 ends as the GOAT. How far does yours go?

Play in your browser: https://bballdestiny.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer
iPhone (App Store): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6819627656?pt=129569111&ct=youtube-trailer&mt=8
Android (Google Play): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bballdestiny.app&referrer=utm_source%3Dyoutube%26utm_medium%3Dvideo%26utm_campaign%3Dtrailer

0:56 Finals MVP, MVP, Hall of Fame
